stories.headline: 9 Kings reaches version 1.0 on November 12 with new modes
stories.summary: Sad Socket's roguelike kingdom builder is scheduled to leave early access today. Version 1.0 expands the card pool and introduces Joker customization, Quest and Endless modes, and asynchronous multiplayer, alongside progression and quality-of-life improvements.

stories.headline: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon expansion arrives November 12
stories.summary: Devolver Digital's expansion is scheduled for today and takes the roguelite above the pit to four new battlefields. It adds eight playable characters, 24 balls, 45 passives, more than 40 enemies and 20 new buildings. Players need the base game, and the expansion content becomes accessible after completing it.

stories.headline: SONIC PICO PARK brings 2-to-8-player co-op to PC on November 12
stories.summary: TECOPARK and PICO PARK Inc. are scheduled to launch a Sonic the Hedgehog crossover puzzle-platformer today. Two to eight players can tackle cooperative levels locally or online, using familiar Sonic mechanics such as Spin Dash, loops, springs and rings. Online play supports cross-platform multiplayer.

stories.headline: Resident Evil Requiem wins Golden Joystick GOTY; Crimson Desert takes PC prize
stories.summary: At the November 11 Golden Joystick Awards, Resident Evil Requiem won Ultimate Game of the Year, Console Game of the Year, Best Game Trailer and Best Lead Performer. Crimson Desert was voted PC Game of the Year.

stories.headline: Path of Exile's Covens of Umbra expansion launches November 13
stories.summary: Grinding Gear Games plans to release its free Covens of Umbra expansion on November 13 Pacific time. The new challenge league introduces witch covens, boss Fates that increase difficulty and rewards, and customizable Wickerman powers. Scarabs make way for Threads of Creation, alongside a redesigned Atlas passive tree and loot changes.

stories.headline: The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past uses AI to restore Geralt's Polish voice
stories.summary: CD Projekt Red says Polish Geralt actor Jacek Rozenek recorded his dialogue for the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion, then consented to Respeecher processing those recordings to resemble his earlier performance. The approach was chosen because his voice changed following a 2019 stroke; the studio says it was not used to replace his acting.

stories.headline: Beyond Skyrim: Bruma 2.0 expands the mod and reaches PlayStation
stories.summary: The free Skyrim mod's 2.0 update adds dungeons, a larger explorable area, equipment, spells and improvements to existing content. It also brings Bruma to PS4 and PS5. Saves from older versions are incompatible, so returning players must start a new save.

stories.headline: Former id Software developers found Hidden Horses and unveil Danger Pay
stories.summary: More than 20 former id Software developers have formed employee-owned studio Hidden Horses following layoffs. Its debut project, Danger Pay, is a single-player FPS inspired by deadly game shows, The Running Man and Smash TV, with a Kickstarter campaign seeking development funding.

stories.headline: Black Forest Games buys itself out of THQ Nordic and forms Third Signal
stories.summary: The studio behind the Destroy All Humans remakes is independent again following a management buyout from THQ Nordic. Black Forest Games is the founding member of new studio group Third Signal, which plans to support developer-led premium PC and console games. Other member studios have not yet been announced.

stories.headline: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra reportedly remains in development
stories.summary: After a social-media cancellation rumour, Bloomberg's Jason Schreier reported that Skydance Games told Marvel 1943 developers the project had not been cancelled and work was continuing toward its next milestone. The previously delayed game has no confirmed release date, and the report does not guarantee that its plans cannot change.

stories.headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved will add four-player Firefight this winter
stories.summary: Halo Studios' remake is getting a free four-player PvE Firefight mode in a winter update. Xbox has not announced an exact release date. More details are planned for Halo Fest on December 12-13, and Xbox FanFest attendees can try the mode on November 12.

stories.headline: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide adds Sisters Novitiate on December 7
stories.summary: Fatshark's new paid Sisters Novitiate class brings the Adepta Sororitas to Tertium with Faith-driven abilities and a distinct talent system. The December 7 launch also includes a free update adding the Meltagun, which both Sisters Novitiate and Veteran players can use.

stories.headline: GDC survey: 34% of respondents faced layoffs in the past two years
stories.summary: A new GDC State of the Game Industry survey of more than 2,600 professionals found 34% had been laid off in the previous two years, up from 28% in the earlier survey. Of those reporting layoffs, 54% said they were still unemployed. These figures describe survey respondents, not the entire global industry.
